Graduate Studies
Graduate Studies
The Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies serves prospective and current graduate students from the moment they apply to the University to the time they receive their degrees at convocation. To do so, it provides oversight for all of the University’s graduate programs and collaborates with individual units to ensure clarity and transparency of their program requirements and practices.
